why_hire: I bring a unique combination of full-stack expertise, AI/ML capabilities, and system design experience validated by a 9.7 CGPA and 12+ national hackathons. My portfolio demonstrates 20+ production-grade applications with clean architecture, comprehensive testing, and real-world deployment. I excel at building scalable systems from scratch - whether it's implementing circuit breakers for resilience, integrating payment systems like Razorpay, creating real-time collaboration tools with WebSockets, or developing RAG-based AI assistants. My experience spans the entire stack: responsive React frontends, robust Node.js/FastAPI backends, MongoDB database design, JWT/RBAC authentication, and cloud deployment. I've proven I can rapidly prototype under hackathon pressure while maintaining code quality (Top 3 in hardware innovation, SIH 2025 qualification). Whether it's a complex web application, AI-powered system, real-time dashboard, or IoT project, I have the technical depth, practical experience, and problem-solving mindset to deliver results. I'm seeking opportunities to contribute to scalable web applications and continue growing as a full-stack engineer.
